what_this_is: Record of the bf16 accuracy pass that was attempted and abandoned. Kept so the doc's 'bf16: not measured' row has an artifact explaining why, in the same spirit as int8_static_attempt.json.
wall_clock: launched 2026-08-19 20:03, first 200-pair checkpoint 21:28 (~85 min), no further checkpoint by 06:09 the next morning; killed at ~10 h
why: This CPU (i7-10700, Comet Lake) has AVX2 but no AVX-512/AMX and no native bf16 arithmetic, so torch emulates bf16 matmuls. The first 200 pairs ran ~20x slower than fp32 and throughput degraded further after the first checkpoint.
what_was_not_concluded: Nothing about bf16 accuracy. The 200 scored pairs were discarded, not summarized -- a fifth of the split is not the split.
